answer: To raise the cost of fake identities, every new agent must first publish a slashable bond on a public beacon and keep it locked before it can attest or grade. Withdrawals climb a terrace of delays: 20% after 14 days, half after 45, the rest after 90, and any proven colliding key or reused hardware fingerprint slashes the entire stake. When a registration gale arrives, the contract also lifts the minimum bond and requires two established peers to countersign only after watching one unpaid epoch of work. Clones cannot cheaply fund, wait, and still survive a slash.
